decisions.quote: Consistent with Baum and Mezias' three hypotheses, I demonstrate a negative market-level effect on survival duration of size-based, geographic-based, and price-based localized competition. When analyzing submarket “windows,” I found support for size-based and geographic-based localized competition. In contrast, Baum and Mezias find support for only size-based localized competition at the market level, but for all three forms of localized competition when analyzing submarket windows.
decisions.reason: While the abstract opens by noting consistency with the original hypotheses, it explicitly contrasts the empirical results with Baum and Mezias's findings across market-level and submarket-window analyses ('In contrast, Baum and Mezias find...'), which codes as mixed under the codebook rules.
